Supreme Court of the United States
No. 25A515
JOSE DURAN, INDIVIDUALLY AND AS REPRESENTATIVE OF A CLASS
OF JUDGMENT CREDITORS OF THE ESTATE OF
FERDINAND E. MARCOS,
Applicant
v.
UNITED STATES, ET AL.
O R D E R
UPON FURTHER CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for
the applicant and the response filed thereto,
IT IS ORDERED that the stay heretofore issued by the undersigned on
November 5, 2025, is hereby vacated. Given the Government’s
representation that it will not transfer the funds outside of the United States
before the disposition of any petition for a writ of certiorari, the application
for stay is denied.
/s/ Sonia Sotomayor
Associate Justice of the Supreme
Court of the United States
Dated this 14th
day of November, 2025.
